subject.title: feat: add guarded update retention and handover scaffold

question: Should verified managed-prefix Gateway updates fail before mutation when prior-package retention cannot be created and launch-probed, with `OPENCLAW_UPDATE_NO_ROLLBACK=1` as the operator bypass?
rationale: This is an intentional new update and recovery policy, not a mechanical bug fix; choosing its availability and operator escape hatch requires maintainer ownership of upgrade semantics.

options.title: Sponsor retention-only gate
options.body: Approve the fail-closed eligibility policy after fresh-install and upgrade proof demonstrates the managed-prefix recovery path.

options.title: Keep current update behavior
options.body: Defer retention until state snapshot, migration ordering, and rollback policy are designed together.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Retain only the documented detection and warning work, leaving any update-blocking behavior for a separately approved change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor retention-only gate
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed eligibility policy after fresh-install and upgrade proof demonstrates the managed-prefix recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The draft’s author has assembled the update-safety design and is the most directly connected routing candidate in the available evidence.
